A #Blueface Fan Couldn’t Resist And Had To 👅 Up On Blueface’s Sweaty Back 😭🤣

Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Jamall Porter, is an American rapper, songwriter, and internet personality from Los Angeles, California. Born on January 20, 1997, Blueface rose to fame in 2018 with his breakout hit “Thotiana,” which became a viral sensation thanks to his unique offbeat flow, catchy lyrics, and larger-than-life personality. The song later received remixes featuring Cardi B and YG, helping establish him as one of the most recognizable figures in West Coast hip-hop.

Beyond music, Blueface has become a major social media personality, constantly making headlines for his unpredictable antics, relationships, and family life. He shares two children, Javaughn and Journey, with his longtime partner Jaidyn Alexis, and a son, Johnathan Jr., with Chrisean Rock. His relationships with Jaidyn, Chrisean, and Nevaeh have frequently attracted public attention, with fans following the ongoing drama, reconciliations, and family moments.

In recent years, Blueface has expanded beyond music into livestreaming, building a large audience on Kick by broadcasting his everyday life, entertaining fans, and collaborating with other internet personalities. Following his release from prison in November 2025, he made a major push into streaming with help from fellow rapper and content creator DDG. In November 2026, Blueface claimed he earned $1 million in just 90 days of streaming, showing how he has turned his online popularity into another source of income. iHeartRadio +2

Despite the controversies surrounding his personal life, Blueface remains one of the most talked-about personalities to emerge from the Los Angeles rap scene, continuing to attract attention through his music, viral moments, family life, and growing streaming career.
